plans.name: Single Hotel
plans.for: A clear monthly report on your hotel, with competitor intelligence and a ranked plan.
features: A monthly report for each hotel: what AI says about it, who gets named instead, and what to fix first
Competitor intelligence: which comparable hotels are named, and the pages the assistant cited
Website and external-presence analysis, with the evidence behind each finding
Prioritised recommendations, ranked by risk and effort
Change since your last report, so you can see what moved
Your own questions tested, and your review export analysed

plans.name: Portfolio
plans.for: For groups: a dashboard and ongoing analysis across all your hotels, priced per hotel.
features: Everything in Single Hotel, for every hotel
A portfolio dashboard: every hotel's score, trends and AI visibility side by side
See which hotels need attention, and which are improving
A dashboard for each hotel, showing only that hotel

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.for: For 50 or more hotels, with a tailored quotation.
features: Options available for discussion: portfolio-wide reporting, centralised dashboards, cross-property benchmarking, consolidated billing, custom reporting, additional account support and tailored implementation arrangements

founding.headline: Become one of our first 10 Founding Hotels
founding.message: Join Presence Pro as an early partner and receive our complete GEO intelligence platform for £49.99/month for your first 12 months. In return, help us shape the platform through your feedback.
benefits: Access to the core Presence Pro platform
A monthly GEO assessment of your hotel
AI recommendation visibility, sampled each month
Prioritised recommendations, ranked by risk and effort
Historical performance tracking, building up month by month from your first report
£49.99 a month for your first 12 months
asks: Occasional feedback on the reports and the platform
Help us understand which recommendations you find most useful
Permission to use your results, anonymised, to improve the platform
Consider (never required) sharing a testimonial or case study, which would only ever happen with your separate, explicit approval
